name: Shankhpushpi
actions: Traditionally used as a brain tonic (medhya)
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; taken as a syrup, powder in milk, or juice.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: Several different plants are sold as shankhpushpi; the pharmacopoeia species is Convolvulus prostratus (syn. C. pluricaulis).

cautions.note: Not enough is known; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.

interactions.effect: In studies it lowered phenytoin levels and seizure control; do not combine.

evidence.summary: Mostly animal studies on memory and anxiety; very few small human studies.
